name: ScaleUp with AWS: Keynote + Panel Discussion
description:
Building a tech startup no longer requires a million-dollar seed round or a 10-person dev team. In the era of modern cloud computing and generative AI, tiny teams can ship scalable, production-grade products overnight—if they know how to architect lean from day one.
Join AWS Student Builder Group Laurier and Startup Lab Laurier for an evening focused on the intersection of cloud economics, startup architecture, and tactical venture growth. Whether you are a business student with an idea, an aspiring product manager, or a student founder working on your next MVP, this event is designed to give you an actionable roadmap to launch and scale cost-effectively.

\### What to Expect

* Keynote: The $0 to MVP Playbook; Aaron Brighton (Senior Startup Solutions Architect at AWS) breaks down how non-technical and hybrid founders can leverage modern cloud architectures to launch rapidly without burning runway. Discover how to avoid early technical debt, keep idle costs near zero using serverless, build with generative AI, and access startup programs like AWS Activate.
* Networking & Refreshments Connect with local student founders, innovators from Startup Lab, and tech enthusiasts. Food and drinks will be provided.
* Fireside Panel & Practical Scaling Discussion A hard-hitting panel featuring Rohini Gaonkar (Sr. Developer Advocate at AWS), Brett Gillett (Founder & Cloud/GenAI Specialist at Curious Orbit), and surprise guest panelists from the local tech ecosystem. They will discuss real-world architectural tradeoffs, cloud finance (FinOps), and what actually works in production.

\| 7:30 PM – 8:45 PM | Industry Speaker Panel: Featuring Rohini Gaonkar, Brett Gillett, and guest experts |

\### Who Should Attend?

* Aspiring Founders & Business Students: Learn how to scope MVPs, lead technical initiatives, and apply for up to six figures in AWS startup credits.

name: The Serverless Side of AWS
description:
The Serverless Side of AWS

Discover how to build scalable applications on AWS without the hassle of managing servers!

In this session, we'll explore the world of Serverless Architecture and understand how AWS services make application development faster, more efficient, and scalable.

What We'll Cover

* Understanding Serverless: Zero server management, pay-as-you-go pricing, and automatic scaling.
* Core AWS Services: An introduction to AWS Lambda, Amazon API Gateway, and Amazon DynamoDB.
* Live Architecture Walkthrough: See how these services work together to power a real-world application.
* Engineering Challenges: Explore concepts like cold starts, state management, and practical trade-offs.
* Building with Serverless: Learn how to use these services in your hackathon projects and personal applications.

What You'll Learn

By the end of this session, you'll have a better understanding of how to:

* Build and deploy applications without managing servers.
* Connect core AWS services to create functional applications.
* Handle real-world application requirements and engineering challenges.
* Build scalable projects for your next hackathon or portfolio.`
  `

Whether you're just getting started with AWS or looking to explore new ways of building applications, this session will help you take your cloud development skills further.

name: Agentic Software Delivery: A Fireside Chat with AWS DevEx Researchers @ AWS Builder Loft Berlin
description:
Agentic Software Delivery: A Fireside Chat with AWS DevEx Researchers

As AI reshapes how software gets built, developers and leaders face a new set of questions. How do teams use tokens most efficiently and keep AI costs stable? How can teams best address new bottlenecks, like code review? And what are the emerging practices for building software factories and a true AI-native SDLC?

Join Laura Tacho and Nathen Harvey, two industry experts on developer productivity, for a candid fireside conversation grounded in their latest work. They'll dig into the data on what is really helping orgs win with AI, share trends and insights about tokenomics, ROI, and new bottlenecks, and offer their take on where agentic development is headed. Expect a frank discussion on what works and how to measure it, from DORA metrics to developer-level signals, and plenty of time for Q&A.

Agenda

18:30 - 19:30 Doors open for networking, food, and drinks

19:30 - 20:30 Fireside Chat with Laura and Nathen

20:30 - 21:00 Closing Remarks & Networking

Speakers

Laura Tacho (https://www.linkedin.com/in/lauratacho/)  
Laura is an expert in developer experience and measuring the efficiency of engineering organizations. She currently works on developer experience at AWS, and was previously the CTO of DX, where she led the company's research and advisory practices, helping engineering leaders make better decisions about how and when to invest in devex, platform tooling, and AI. Laura's been working on developer tools for 15 years, including building out some of the first developer tools for the Docker ecosystem, and then on CI/CD and automation tools. In 2021, she started her own executive advisory practice and has worked with over 1500 engineering leaders on developer experience, measuring productivity, and creating high-performing engineering orgs.

Nathen Harvey (https://www.linkedin.com/in/nathen/)  
Nathen is a Principal Technologist on the Developer Experience team at AWS, focusing on software delivery performance, platform engineering, and AI enablement. He previously led DORA at Google Cloud, guiding the industry-standard framework for measuring engineering performance. As the lead author of multiple DORA reports and a former Vice President at Chef, Nathen brings deep expertise in shaping developer ecosystems. He is a frequent keynote speaker, a co-founder of regional DevOpsDays events, and a co-author of 97 Things Every Cloud Engineer Should Know.

We look forward to meeting you all at the AWS Builder Loft!

name: Agentic Security Operations Alliance Roadshow
description: The rise of agentic AI is transforming the SOC — but autonomous agents are only as trustworthy as the data and context they act on. This session brings together AWS, ReversingLabs, and ExtraHop — founding members of the Agentic SOC Alliance — to unpack what it actually takes to run AI agents safely inside a security operations workflow. We'll walk through a real reference architecture spanning network-layer visibility, verified binary-level threat intelligence, and autonomous reasoning, and discuss why "speed" isn't the hard part of agentic security — trust is. name: UG Genova | Agents & Dragons
description:
Once Upon Agentic AI è un workshop hands-on, a tema RPG, pensato per imparare i concetti fondamentali di Strands Agents costruendo passo dopo passo un Game Master per Dungeons & Dragons basato su agenti AI.

Partiremo dalla creazione di un singolo agente e ne estenderemo progressivamente le capacità: svilupperemo tool personalizzati, integreremo un server MCP (Model Context Protocol), introdurremo la comunicazione tra agenti tramite Agent-to-Agent (A2A) e costruiremo una interfaccia web per interagire con il sistema. Infine, ricostruiremo la stessa soluzione utilizzando Strands Harness, per vedere come cambia l’approccio allo sviluppo e all’orchestrazione.

Attraverso un progetto concreto, divertente e progressivo, esploreremo i principali building block dei sistemi agentici moderni e i pattern necessari per creare agenti, dotarli di strumenti e farli collaborare tra loro.

Al termine del workshop avrai sia le competenze pratiche sia i materiali necessari per poter riproporre l’esperienza in autonomia nella tua community.

Real customer stories, not theory: what it actually looks like when a team has to choose between rebuilding from scratch or having architected for this from day one.

Qué es una Watch & Build Party

No se trata únicamente de ver una transmisión en video. Una Watch & Build Party combina dos elementos fundamentales:

1. Watch: Analizamos los anuncios más relevantes presentados en Las Vegas durante re:Invent 2026, explicados en español claro, aterrizado y sin tecnicismos innecesarios.
2. Build: Pasamos de la teoría a la consola. Cada asistente tiene la oportunidad de interactuar con servicios reales de AWS mediante una práctica guiada paso a paso.

Agenda de la sesión

El evento tiene una duración total de dos horas y media, estructurada de forma dinámica para aprovechar al máximo el tiempo en el laboratorio:

* 10:00 - 10:20 | Bienvenida y registro: Apertura del evento, entrega de identificaciones y charla introductoria sobre el impacto de la tecnología en zonas rurales.
* 10:20 - 11:05 | Transmisión guiada de re:Invent: Proyección de los momentos clave del Keynote del Dr. Werner Vogels (CTO de Amazon) enfocado en cómo construir sistemas eficientes, sencillos y con propósito.
* 11:05 - 11:55 | Taller práctico guiado (Build Session): Despliegue de una primera arquitectura web serverless con AWS Lambda y Amazon S3 bajo la capa gratuita de AWS, implementando buenas prácticas de seguridad y permisos mínimos en IAM con asistencia de herramientas modernas de automatización.
* 11:55 - 12:30 | Networking, refrigerio y clausura: Convivencia con pizzas y bebidas, sesión de preguntas y respuestas, dinámicas de trivia técnica, entrega de obsequios oficiales de AWS re:Invent y orientación sobre rutas de certificación y becas de estudio.

Participación comunitaria e invitados especiales

Este evento reúne la colaboración de diversos programas del ecosistema oficial de Amazon Web Services:

* Anfitrión y organizador: AWS User Group Playa Vicente, representado por su fundador y líder comunitario Roberto Flores Segundo (AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner y Lead Auditor ISO 27001:2022).
* Invitada técnica especial: Presencia y participación de Joselyn Lagunas (Shel), miembro del programa oficial AWS Community Builder, quien compartirá su experiencia sobre el aprendizaje continuo y las oportunidades en tecnología.
* Comunidad invitada: Visita y respaldo de la comitiva de AWS Student Builders Group (AWS SBG UNISTMO), encabezada por Jean Paul Gallegos Cruz desde Santo Domingo Tehuantepec, Oaxaca.

Requerimientos y logística para asistentes

* Dirigido a: Estudiantes de bachillerato técnico, docentes del área de informática y personas interesadas en iniciarse en cloud.
* Requisitos técnicos: No se requiere experiencia previa en programación ni contar con tarjeta de crédito. Las prácticas se realizarán en los equipos del laboratorio con cuentas y créditos de prueba.
* Alimentación: Se proporcionará refrigerio completo (pizzas y bebidas) a todos los participantes registrados.

 

El cupo es limitado para garantizar el espacio limite del laboratorio.
